title: The Capitol Theatre

services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: The Capitol Theatre is centrally located at the border of Connecticut and New York, and can be easily accessed via I-287, I-95, Hutchinson River Parkway, Merritt Parkway or Metro-North Train. For specific directions, visit our Directions

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Host your next unforgettable event at the legendary Capitol Theatre, located right across the street from Metro-North’s Port Chester stop. This historic venue can accommodate gatherings of all sizes, from intimate affairs of 10 guests to large-scale events with up to 2,000 attendees. Whether you’re planning a private concert, corporate meeting, team-building off-site, or a celebration like a wedding, holiday party, or birthday, the Capitol Theatre is the perfect setting. Designed in 1926 by renowned architect Thomas W. Lamb, the Capitol Theatre features a stunning 65-foot domed ceiling, a breathtaking balcony, and elegant presidential booths.
